purpose: Bush comparison. D is the selected ordinary-bush proposal; this page does not change shipping game art.
reference: Use the selected apple foliage palette without losing source shading. Show raw source alongside every treatment.

options.name: A · Shipped woodland bush
options.note: Current shipped rustic art. Dense, dark leaf detail; no additional colour adjustment.

options.name: B · Previous proposal
options.note: The preceding sandbox treatment, retained as a comparison with the selected original-source bush.

options.name: C · Restrained woodland
options.note: A smaller apple-led colour and value lift. Keeps the original dark leaf separations and uneven natural outline.

options.name: D · Selected original green source
options.note: Restore the original green bush with its 72% apple-led treatment. Interior lightness contrast is softened by 10%, retaining dark contours and individual pixel shades.

options.name: E · Rounded leaf clusters
options.source: unused_art/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free) 1.5.7/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free)/Art/Trees and Bushes/Bush_Emerald_5.png
options.note: Chunkier, simpler leaf masses suit the small character scale. Apple-led colour tones down the source emerald green.

options.name: F · Low wild bush
options.source: unused_art/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free) 1.5.7/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free)/Art/Trees and Bushes/Bush_Emerald_6.png
options.note: Low, asymmetric shape leaves more ground visible. Clear few-pixel leaf clusters; original proportions retained.

options.name: G · Uneven woodland bush
options.source: unused_art/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free) 1.5.7/The Fan-tasy Tileset (Free)/Art/Trees and Bushes/Bush_Emerald_3.png
options.note: An irregular two-lobed silhouette with broader shading regions. More upright than the low bush, less busy than the shipped art.

options.name: H · Clipped hedge
options.note: A deliberately clipped silhouette for managed planting. Not proposed as the ordinary woodland bush.
